meta.description: Connects segmentation and zero-trust principles to risk reduction.

question.text: Which two practices align with reducing implicit trust and limiting lateral movement? Select two.
options: Segment sensitive systems from general user networks
Continuously verify access based on identity and context
Allow every internal device unrestricted access because it is inside the perimeter
Use one shared administrator account for all staff
correctAnswers: Segment sensitive systems from general user networks
Continuously verify access based on identity and context
